# Subset Myonuclei

```{r, include=FALSE}
Idents(sc_combined) <- "seurat_clusters"

myonuclei_integrated <- subset(sc_combined, idents = "Myonuclei")
```



# Remove unused objects

```{r, include=FALSE}
rm(Agca_snLLC_CTL, Agca_snLLC_LLC, Brown_scLLC_CTL, Brown_scLLC_2w, Brown_scLLC_2.5w, Brown_scLLC_3.5w, Kim_scB16F10_CTL, Kim_scB16F10_B16F10, Pryce_scC26_CTL, Pryce_scC26_C26, Pryce_scKPP_CTL, Pryce_scKPP_KPP, Zhang_snKIC_CTL, Zhang_snKIC_KIC, DEGs_sc_combined, all_genes)
```



# Plot UMAP 

## Highlighting Myonuclei

## UMAP plot highlighting Macrophages

```{r}
DimPlot(
  sc_combined,
  reduction = "umap",
  group.by = "seurat_clusters",
  cells.highlight = list("Myonuclei" = WhichCells(sc_combined, expression = seurat_clusters == "Myonuclei")),
  sizes.highlight = 1,
  pt.size = 1,
  cols.highlight = "#E00000" 
) +
  ggplot2::labs(title = "", x = "UMAP1", y = "UMAP2") +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_blank(),
    axis.text.y = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks = element_blank()) +
  theme(legend.position = "none")

rm(sc_combined)
```


## By subcluster

```{r}
DimPlot(myonuclei_integrated, reduction = "umap", group.by = "subcluster", repel = TRUE, pt.size = 1) +
  ggplot2::labs(title = "", x = "UMAP1", y = "UMAP2") +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_blank(), axis.text.y = element_blank(), axis.ticks = element_blank())
```


## By condition

```{r}
DimPlot(myonuclei_integrated, reduction = "umap", group.by = "orig.ident", repel = TRUE, pt.size = 1) +

```



# Plot stacked barplot for subcluster proportions

## For each condition
```{r, include=FALSE}
myonuclei_integrated_cluster_proportions <- myonuclei_integrated@meta.data %>%
  dplyr::select(orig.ident, subcluster) %>%
  group_by(orig.ident, subcluster) %>%
  summarize(count = n()) %>%
  group_by(orig.ident) %>%
  mutate(percentage = count / sum(count) * 100)
```

```{r, include=FALSE}
write.csv(myonuclei_integrated_cluster_proportions, file = "myonuclei_integrated_cluster_proportions.csv", row.names = TRUE)
```

```{r}
myonuclei_integrated_cluster_proportions$orig.ident <- factor(
  myonuclei_integrated_cluster_proportions$orig.ident,
  levels = c("Agca_snLLC_CTL", "Agca_snLLC_LLC", "Brown_scLLC_CTL", "Brown_scLLC_2w", "Brown_scLLC_2.5w", "Brown_scLLC_3.5w", "Kim_scB16F10_CTL", "Kim_scB16F10_B16F10", "Pryce_scC26_CTL", "Pryce_scC26_C26", "Pryce_scKPP_CTL", "Pryce_scKPP_KPP", "Zhang_snKIC_CTL", "Zhang_snKIC_KIC"
),
  labels = c("Agca CTL", "Agca LLC", "Brown CTL", "Brown LLC (2w)",
"Brown LLC (2.5w)", "Brown LLC (3.5w)", "Kim CTL", "Kim B16F10",
"Pryce (C26) CTL", "Pryce C26", "Pryce (KPP) CTL", "Pryce KPP",
"Zhang CTL", "Zhang KIC"
))

ggplot(myonuclei_integrated_cluster_proportions, aes(x = orig.ident, y = percentage, fill = subcluster)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", width = 0.75, color = "black") +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent_format(scale = 1), expand = c(0, 0)) +
  labs(title = "", x = "", y = "Proportion") +
  theme(legend.position = "right", panel.background = element_blank(), axis.line = element_line(color = "black"), axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)) +
  guides(fill = guide_legend(title = NULL))
```

# GO terms and KEGG pathway analyses for tumour-bearing myonuclei

## Get DEGs in tumour-bearing myonuclei

```{r, include=FALSE}
Idents(myonuclei_integrated) <- "orig.ident"

DEGs_cachectic_myonuclei_integrated <- FindMarkers(myonuclei_integrated, ident.1 = c("Agca_snLLC_LLC", "Brown_scLLC_3.5w", "Kim_scB16F10_B16F10", "Pryce_scC26_C26", "Pryce_scKPP_KPP", "Zhang_snKIC_KIC"), ident.2 = c("Agca_snLLC_CTL", "Brown_scLLC_CTL", "Kim_scB16F10_CTL", "Pryce_scC26_CTL", "Pryce_scKPP_CTL", "Zhang_snKIC_CTL"), logfc.threshold = 0, min.pct = 0.10, verbose = FALSE)
```


## Subset DEG for p_val_adj < 0.05

```{r, include=FALSE}
DEGs_cachectic_myonuclei_integrated <- na.omit(DEGs_cachectic_myonuclei_integrated)
DEGs_cachectic_myonuclei_integrated <- subset(DEGs_cachectic_myonuclei_integrated, p_val_adj < 0.05)
```

```{r, include=FALSE}
write.csv(DEGs_cachectic_myonuclei_integrated, file = "DEGs_cachectic_myonuclei_integrated.csv")
```


## Take the row names of the specified genes in each condition that have an -2 > avg_log2FC > 0.2

```{r, include=FALSE}
DEGs_cachectic_myonuclei_integrated_up <- rownames(DEGs_cachectic_myonuclei_integrated[DEGs_cachectic_myonuclei_integrated$avg_log2FC > 0.2,])

DEGs_cachectic_myonuclei_integrated_down <- rownames(DEGs_cachectic_myonuclei_integrated[DEGs_cachectic_myonuclei_integrated$avg_log2FC < -0.2,])
```


## Run GO analysis

```{r, include=FALSE}
DEGs_cachectic_myonuclei_integrated_upgo <- enrichGO(gene = DEGs_cachectic_myonuclei_integrated_up, OrgDb = "org.Mm.eg.db", keyType = "SYMBOL", ont = "BP")
DEGs_cachectic_myonuclei_integrated_downgo <- enrichGO(gene = DEGs_cachectic_myonuclei_integrated_down, OrgDb = "org.Mm.eg.db", keyType = "SYMBOL", ont = "BP")
```


## .csv for GO terms

```{r, include=FALSE}
write.csv(DEGs_cachectic_myonuclei_integrated_upgo, file = "myonuclei_integrated_upgo.csv", row.names = TRUE)
write.csv(DEGs_cachectic_myonuclei_integrated_downgo, file = "myonuclei_integrated_downgo.csv", row.names = TRUE)
```


## Visualize GO terms

### Catabolism UP (manually sampled top 100 terms for those related to catabolism - 23/top 100)

```{r}
catabolism_up <- c(1, 4, 7, 9, 24, 27, 29, 35, 52, 57, 60, 62, 65, 67, 70, 77, 79, 83, 84, 85, 88, 94, 97)
go_catabolism_up <- DEGs_cachectic_myonuclei_integrated_upgo[catabolism_up, ]

go_catabolism_up$Description <- gsub(" - Mus musculus \\(house mouse\\)$", "", go_catabolism_up$Description)

ggplot(go_catabolism_up, aes(x = FoldEnrichment, 
                           y = reorder(Description, FoldEnrichment),
                           size = Count, 
                           color = p.adjust)) +
  geom_point() +
  scale_color_gradient(low = "blue", high = "red", name = "adj. p-value") +
  labs(x = "Fold Enrichment", y = NULL, 
       title = "UP GO Integrated Myonuclei - Catabolism-related terms") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    axis.line = element_line(color = "black"),
    axis.ticks = element_line(color = "black")
  )
```

## KEGG pathway analysis

```{r, include=FALSE}
### Convert gene symbols to Entrez IDs
DEGs_cachectic_myonuclei_integrated_upIDs <- bitr(DEGs_cachectic_myonuclei_integrated_up,
                  fromType = "SYMBOL",
                  toType   = "ENTREZID",
                  OrgDb    = org.Mm.eg.db)

DEGs_cachectic_myonuclei_integrated_upkegg <- enrichKEGG(
  gene         = DEGs_cachectic_myonuclei_integrated_upIDs$ENTREZID,
  organism     = "mmu",
  keyType      = "kegg",
  pvalueCutoff = 0.05
)


DEGs_cachectic_myonuclei_integrated_downIDs <- bitr(DEGs_cachectic_myonuclei_integrated_down,
                  fromType = "SYMBOL",
                  toType   = "ENTREZID",
                  OrgDb    = org.Mm.eg.db)

DEGs_cachectic_myonuclei_integrated_downkegg <- enrichKEGG(
  gene         = DEGs_cachectic_myonuclei_integrated_downIDs$ENTREZID,
  organism     = "mmu",
  keyType      = "kegg",
  pvalueCutoff = 0.05
)
```


## .csv for KEGG pathways

```{r, include=FALSE}
write.csv(DEGs_cachectic_myonuclei_integrated_upkegg, file = "myonuclei_integrated_upkegg.csv", row.names = TRUE)

write.csv(DEGs_cachectic_myonuclei_integrated_downkegg, file = "myonuclei_integrated_downkegg.csv", row.names = TRUE)
```

# Heatmap to show tumour communication to Satellite cells, Myoblasts, Myonuclei

```{r}
tumour_to_myonuclei_counts_mat <- cellchat_tb_secreted@net$count[
  c("Tumour Malignant cells", "Tumour Endothelial cells", "Tumour Cancer-associated fibroblasts", "Tumour Monocytes/macrophages", "Tumour Neutrophils", "Tumour B cells", "Tumour T cells", "Tumour NK cells"),
  c("Muscle Satellite cells", "Muscle Myoblasts", "Muscle Myonuclei")]

pheatmap(
  tumour_to_myonuclei_counts_mat,
  color = colorRampPalette(c("white", "red"))(15),
  breaks = seq(0, 15, length.out = 16),
  cluster_rows = FALSE,
  cluster_cols = FALSE,
  fontsize = 8,
  angle_col = 45,
  cellwidth = 10,
  cellheight = 10
  )
```



# Heatmap of change in muscle cell communication to Satellite cells, Myoblasts, Myonuclei

```{r}
ctl_muscle_myonuclei_counts_mat <- cellchat_ctl_all@net$count[
  c("Muscle Satellite cells", "Muscle Myoblasts", "Muscle Myonuclei", "Muscle Endothelial cells", "Muscle vSMCs", "Muscle Pericytes", "Muscle FAPs", "Muscle Tenocytes", "Muscle Platelets", "Muscle Mast cells", "Muscle Dendritic cells", "Muscle Monocytes", "Muscle Macrophages", "Muscle Neutrophils", "Muscle B cells", "Muscle T cells", "Muscle NK cells", "Muscle Neural/glial cells", "Muscle Schwann cells"),
  c("Muscle Satellite cells", "Muscle Myoblasts", "Muscle Myonuclei")]

tb_muscle_myonuclei_counts_mat <- cellchat_tb_all@net$count[
  c("Muscle Satellite cells", "Muscle Myoblasts", "Muscle Myonuclei", "Muscle Endothelial cells", "Muscle vSMCs", "Muscle Pericytes", "Muscle FAPs", "Muscle Tenocytes", "Muscle Platelets", "Muscle Mast cells", "Muscle Dendritic cells", "Muscle Monocytes", "Muscle Macrophages", "Muscle Neutrophils", "Muscle B cells", "Muscle T cells", "Muscle NK cells", "Muscle Neural/glial cells", "Muscle Schwann cells"),
  c("Muscle Satellite cells", "Muscle Myoblasts", "Muscle Myonuclei")]

diff_counts_mat <- tb_muscle_myonuclei_counts_mat - ctl_muscle_myonuclei_counts_mat

n_neg <- 35   # -35 → 0
n_pos <- 35   # 0 → 35

# Create two color gradients
neg_colours <- colorRampPalette(c("blue", "white"))(n_neg)
pos_colours <- colorRampPalette(c("white", "red"))(n_pos)
colours <- c(neg_colours, pos_colours)

# Define breaks to match colors
breaks <- seq(-35, 35, length.out = length(colours) + 1)

# Plot
pheatmap(
  diff_counts_mat,
  color = colours,
  breaks = breaks,
  cluster_rows = FALSE,
  cluster_cols = FALSE,
  fontsize = 8,
  angle_col = 45,
  cellwidth = 10,
  cellheight = 10
)
```


## Remove unused objects

```{r, include=FALSE}
rm(ctl_muscle_myonuclei_counts_mat, tb_muscle_myonuclei_counts_mat, diff_counts_mat, tumour_to_myonuclei_counts_mat, breaks, colours, n_neg, n_pos, neg_colours, pos_colours)
```



# Heatmap to show communication within the muscle (all muscle cells)

```{r}
ctl_counts_mat <- cellchat_ctl_all@net$count[
  c("Muscle Satellite cells", "Muscle Myoblasts", "Muscle Myonuclei", "Muscle Endothelial cells", "Muscle vSMCs", "Muscle Pericytes", "Muscle FAPs", "Muscle Tenocytes", "Muscle Platelets", "Muscle Mast cells", "Muscle Dendritic cells", "Muscle Monocytes", "Muscle Macrophages", "Muscle Neutrophils", "Muscle B cells", "Muscle T cells", "Muscle NK cells", "Muscle Neural/glial cells", "Muscle Schwann cells"),
  c("Muscle Satellite cells", "Muscle Myoblasts", "Muscle Myonuclei", "Muscle Endothelial cells", "Muscle vSMCs", "Muscle Pericytes", "Muscle FAPs", "Muscle Tenocytes", "Muscle Platelets", "Muscle Mast cells", "Muscle Dendritic cells", "Muscle Monocytes", "Muscle Macrophages", "Muscle Neutrophils", "Muscle B cells", "Muscle T cells", "Muscle NK cells", "Muscle Neural/glial cells", "Muscle Schwann cells")]

pheatmap(
```

```{r}
diff_counts_mat <- tb_counts_mat - ctl_counts_mat

n_neg <- 100   # -100 → 0
n_pos <- 100   # 0 → 100

pos_colours <- colorRampPalette(c("white", "red"))(n_pos)
colours <- c(neg_colours, pos_colours)

# Define breaks to match colors
breaks <- seq(-100, 100, length.out = length(colours) + 1)

# Plot
pheatmap(
  diff_counts_mat,

  breaks = breaks,

  cluster_cols = FALSE,
  fontsize = 8,
  angle_col = 45,
  cellwidth = 10,
  cellheight = 10
)
```


### NOTES OF ENRICHED SIGNALING PATHWAYS, FUNCTIONS, AND CONTEXT WITH CACHEXIA.

#### SLITRK - NMJ stability and remodeling.
#### AGRN - NMJ formation and maintenance. 
#### FGF - Promotes stress response, allows for myogenic fusion, myonuclear incorporation, coordination of differentiation. Works with HSPG.
#### BMP - TGFbeta superfamily, known to impair myogenic differentiation.
#### HSPG - ECM/cell surface signaling, bind IGF and FGF.
#### NRXN - Synaptic adhesion. 
#### LAMININ - Fibre integrity. 
#### DHEA - Anabolic and anti-catabolic hormone signaling, is a precursor for androgens and estrogens.
#### THBS - ECM remodeling for NMJ synapse formation and stabilization. 

### Can sub-divide these pathways into 3 categories: NMJ (SLITRK, AGRN, NRXN, THBS), nutrients/growth factor/hormone signaling (FGF, BMP, HSPG, DHEA), ECM signaling (Laminin). Maybe also look at IGF signaling changes even though it is not significant on the information flow.



# Check the genes associated with each pathway

```{r, include=FALSE}
# Function to get all canonical genes for a pathway
get_canonical_genes <- function(pathway){

# subset the database by the pathway
lr_pairs <- subset(CellChatDB$interaction, pathway_name == pathway)
  
# collect all ligands and receptors
genes <- unique(c(lr_pairs$ligand.symbol, lr_pairs$receptor.symbol))
  
  return(genes)
}

# Example: get genes for FGF
fgf_genes <- get_canonical_genes("FGF")
fgf_genes
```

```{r, include=FALSE}
    .groups = "drop"
  )
```

```{r}
print(means_ecm_assembly_score)
```

```{r, include=FALSE}
write.csv(means_ecm_assembly_score, file = "ecm_assembly_score.csv", row.names = FALSE)
```

### NOTE - Paired T-TESTs on each cell type by condition, INCREASED ECM assembly in Neutrophils and T cells, REDUCED ECM disassembly in Satellite cells, Endothelial cells, Pericytes, FAPs, Tenocytes, Platelets.
